get.description:
Return the signed-in user and the CSRF token for a reloaded browser page.

The session cookie is HttpOnly, so the SPA cannot read the CSRF token from it after a
reload. A GET is exempt from CSRF and returns the token the next mutation needs.

Estimate a batch without creating documents, so the UI can show the cost first.

The same upload rules apply: ZIP entries are sanitised and the total size and count
limits are enforced. No parsing, no model call and no document row.

post.description:
Set a new password without email and end every existing session of that user.

``users:manage`` is a privileged permission, so the resetter has TOTP; the target does
not need an email address. Old sessions and TOTP recovery codes are invalidated so a
compromised session cannot survive the reset.
